title: Cookie mode: CSRF cookie and the shared refresh (hosted storefront)
caption: Two concurrent writes of the storefront's client family (the root client and its withOptions({ currency }) child). One GET /v1/storefront issues the missing CSRF cookie; one POST /v1/auth/refresh serves both calls answered 401 TOKEN_EXPIRED; each call is sent again once with its own Idempotency-Key. internal/session.js (sendWithCsrf, fetchCsrf, refreshCookies).

steps.label: checkout.setTravelers(…) and account.update(…) at the same time
ONE GET /api/v1/storefront (cache: no-store), shared by both writes
PUT …/travelers and PATCH /v1/account with X-CSRF-Token (cookies sent by the browser, credentials: same-origin)
401 TOKEN_EXPIRED for both (the API did nothing)
refreshCookies: no refresh in flight and generation unchanged → start ONE refresh (root client's transport settings)
both writes sent again once, same Idempotency-Key where the operation takes one
results; session tokens never reach page code
steps.note: If the refresh is refused with 401 (REFRESH_TOKEN_INVALID or REFRESH_TOKEN_REUSED) the starting client's onSessionExpired runs once and every waiting call rejects with that AuthenticationError. A second 403 CSRF_TOKEN_INVALID is thrown, never looped on.
